articles.title: Dr. Dre Says the Only People Who See AI as a Threat Are Those ‘Who Have Trouble Creating’ - Variety
articles.description: Dr. Dre sees AI as another tool in the music-tech toolbox and said the only people who see AI as a threat are those 'who have trouble creating.'
articles.content: Dr. Dre, the legendary hip-hop producer and performer, sees AI as another tool in the music-tech toolbox akin to synthesizers — and asserted that only people “who have trouble creating” are afraid of… [+2543 chars]
